workflow: Seven registered 4x4 UV-island sheets; final PNGs reconstructed at exactly four times each native's size. Existing generic tyre and atlas PNGs reused by reference.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production GTA San Andreas wheel texture atlas. Edit this registered 2048x2048 sheet into a high definition PAINTED replacement. Keep the exact 4 by 4 grid, pixel-aligned cell locations, the exact magenta (#ff00ff) gutters and margins, and every texture rectangle's bounds. Each cell is an independent UV island, NOT a complete wheel photograph: retain the exact crop, orientation, concentric arc radii, centre position, bolt holes, slot count, straight panel divisions and colors of that cell. Many are quarter wheel faces whose centre is outside the image or at the bottom right corner: NEVER recenter or complete those wheels. Remove pixel stair steps and repaint crisp smoothly curved machined steel, aged alloy, black rubber and existing flat metal patches with fine realistic surface grain; retain stock designs, contrast, value, subtle wear and darkness. No new parts, no perspective, no bevelled sheet borders, no text, no lighting scene. The magenta is a registration mask, leave it perfectly flat and unchanged; don't tint the texture with it. Output exactly 2048x2048.
additional_prompt_batches_02_to_07: Where a cell is mostly black, plain gray, or plain white, preserve that subtle material swatch without inventing bolt holes or arbitrary features. Preserve the separate rectangular subregions of packed texture patches exactly. Don't turn brake strips and panel patches into wheel faces.
